name: three-forma-styli
description: TypeScript-first design token generator with luminance-based color control

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/core test && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/compiler test && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/cli test
scripts.check:packages: publint packages/core && publint packages/themes && publint packages/compiler && publint packages/cli
scripts.check:fonttools: pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/core build && pnpm --filter @three-forma-styli/compiler build && node scripts/verify-fonttools-provenance.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm check:format && pnpm check:versions && pnpm build:all && pnpm check:split && pnpm test && pnpm check:workbench
scripts.check:release: pnpm check && pnpm check:packages && pnpm check:concurrent-pack && node scripts/verify-packed-release.mjs && pnpm check:integration
scripts.review:example: pnpm build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js build examples/project && node packages/cli/dist/index.js review serve examples/project

author: three
